name: python-code-validator
description: Validate, repair and sandbox-run AI-generated Python: lint, types, security and exact fixes.

settings.name: Validator API key
settings.description: Optional. Without one the bridge mints a free key on first use, good for 100 static validations a day. A configured key adds repair and execute. Get one with: curl -s -X POST https://api.statemind.ai/v1/keys
